description: Check claim-stream-order with a real five-entry decided history, snapshot of original positions [0,3), and subscription from zero. Observe initial catch-up and a fixed 250ms continuation window; compare the original-log ranks of all emitted retained Decided entries.

harness.description: Build a real three-node cluster, decide five unique values, read their original order, and snapshot the first three entries through the public API. Move the snapshotted core into the actor and subscribe from zero with capacity 32. Consume initial catch-up and every following item until a fixed time cutoff, then verify the underlying retained decided suffix remains unchanged. Compute order from the independently observed original positions, not payload magnitude.
semantic_changes: No target modifications or injected protocol/storage state.
Test Entry has a snapshot that stores and concatenates the represented prefix values.
Public AsyncRuntime hooks use real Tokio spawn and timers.

legality.derivation: Three fresh valid nodes form leadership through actual protocol messages. Every appended value is decided on all peers before local snapshot(3,true). The snapshot trait stores the actual prefix; subsequent public reads confirm a summary at boundary 3 followed by the two retained entries. No actor API promises an empty initial log: spawn_actor accepts the live core and initializes its cursors from its current metadata. SubscribeDecided is processed before the following same-command-channel barrier. Core safety prefix work occurs before actor startup; actor ticking and event/network drains are active throughout subscription observation.
legality.applicability: One subscription below subscriber/channel capacity; no dropped network traffic, leadership transition, further append, compaction, restart or storage failure during observation. Unique original values are verified, and their observed positions provide a stable order oracle.
unresolved: Finite output observation establishes order only for the completed window; no inference of unbounded progress or deadline compliance.

grounding.derivation: The same subscription receiver supplies every observed item. Retained Decided payloads are mapped to their unique positions in a separately read decided log before compaction. order_preserved is the conjunction of nondecreasing adjacent positions, ignoring snapshot markers; equality is allowed, so the predicate does not strengthen log order to exactly-once delivery. The fixed cutoff is independent of the predicate. Final public read confirms the underlying retained log is stable.
grounding.applicability: Only a completed observation window after declared legal snapshot/subscription prerequisites supplies a result. Missing catch-up, unknown entry correlation or premature stream closure is incomplete.
unresolved: No completion of the unbounded stream is claimed; the result is a safety comparison over the observed finite prefix.

observable_properties.description: Observed retained Decided entries in one stream must not reverse original log positions. Snapshot-marker count is not compared to original log extent.

uncertainties: A bounded prefix with no reversal would not settle all possible future schedules.
No claim about duplicate markers, missing compacted values or stream liveness.
The requirement concerns consumption order, not agreement among replica logs.
